properties.title: BIS keeps the Affiliates (50 percent) rule suspended past 10 Nov 2026
properties.summary: 85% chance BIS files a further stay before the rule returns automatically on 10 Nov: Treasury and China's commerce ministry say the trade truce runs to 10 Jan 2027, and USTR has proposed extending its matching suspension; BIS had filed nothing by 30 Oct.

alternatives.hypothesis: The rule returns to effect on 10 Nov 2026
alternatives.tell_apart: a BIS stay document on Federal Register public inspection by 10 Nov

alternatives.hypothesis: BIS replaces the rule with a modified version
alternatives.tell_apart: the text of any BIS document filed 2 to 10 Nov

resolution.rule: Yes if a BIS Federal Register document that stays or delays the 10 Nov 2026 reimposition of the Affiliates rule (90 FR 47201; stay 90 FR 50857), with an effective date on or before 10 Nov 2026, is on public inspection or published by 11:59 PM ET on 17 Nov 2026. No otherwise.
resolution.source: federalregister.gov (RIN 0694-AK34 family) and the eCFR for 15 CFR 744
resolution.void_if: a deciding BIS document was on public inspection before this forecast's published_at

properties.title: FAO Food Price Index for October 2026 higher than September (6 Nov 2026 release)
properties.summary: 5% chance FAO's 6 Nov release shows October's index above September's: October price data through 29 Oct put cereals, vegetable oils and meat lower and only sugar higher, about 2.4 points down.

properties.title: EASA renews its Iran (FIR Tehran) conflict-zone bulletin (CZIB-2026-04-R2) past 16 Nov 2026
properties.summary: 95% chance EASA extends CZIB-2026-04-R2 beyond its 16 Nov 2026 expiry: none of the six Middle East bulletins has missed a renewal, there is no ceasefire, and past lapses each followed one.

alternatives.hypothesis: The bulletin lapses or is withdrawn
alternatives.tell_apart: EASA's CZIB table on 17 Nov: status and valid-until date

alternatives.hypothesis: It is converted to an Information Note
alternatives.tell_apart: the same table and EASA's Information Notes page

resolution.rule: Yes if, on a check after 00:00 UTC on 17 Nov 2026 (repeated by 30 Nov), EASA's CZIB page, CSV or RSS, or an Internet Archive copy, shows CZIB-2026-04 active, revised on or before 16 Nov 2026 and valid beyond 16 Nov 2026. A successor CZIB for the same airspace counts only if active on 17 Nov and not weaker. No if it is withdrawn, suspended, converted to an Information Note, or revised only after 16 Nov.
resolution.source: EASA Conflict Zone Information Bulletins (page, CSV export, RSS)
resolution.void_if: EASA published a renewal or withdrawal of this bulletin before this forecast's published_at
